title: Pay with Westpac Credit Card for 10% Back at Special Gift Cards (One Use Only, up to $10 Back) @ Westpac Rewards
body:
Deal: Pay with Westpac Credit Card for 10% Back at Special Gift Cards (One Use Only, up to $10 Back) @ Westpac Rewards

[ddoraaaaa] I dont get these special gift cards… does NAB/Commbank/Westpac pay for the cashback out of their pocket? does SGC pay the banks a commission? Is it money laundering?
[Twilight1234] they're banking on breakage aka people not using it - these are honestly so ridiculously hard to use with so many buttons and screens. If 10% of these are not redeemed then they make money already
[netsurfer] It's either SGC provides the discount or co-funded. I tried to use a SGC card at JB today, but the staff refused to let me buy an Apple gift card with that (understandable, but I wondered if I didn't ask in advance, whether JB's system can tell).
Another annoying thing is the refund part. A relative used her gift card. Normally, once the card is completely used, we would delete the card (if digital) or throw away the card (if physical). The product she bought broke 6 months later and the refund can only go back to that card which she no longer has (it was a physical card).
You also don't get extended insurance on purchases with these (where some credit cards offer). So bear that in mind. Not a fan of these gift cards, but I think the NAB deal was 20% off ($100), so I FOMO purchased one.
[flud] They likely won't be able to tell if you're paying with a special card
[FlipperMeTimbers] i bought an apple gift card from apples website using the i think techhead card or something with the amex deals
[desperate] If you purchase the Explorer Card it can be used at Amazon to buy amazon gift cards, also at supermarkets as well for petrol stations for fuel.
[Craze] Not targeted- have a Platinum CC with Westpac 😢
[jc209964] Thanks, OP. Wouldn't have picked up on it if it hadn't been for your post.
[ilovefullprice] How do we check if we have been targeted for this deal? When I check the “Westpac Rewards” section in my Westpac app, it errors out when the page tries to open
[JHoliday] Use the search field to search for Special
I couldn’t find it any other way
[ilovefullprice] Ok thanks found it. Looks like I am not targeted?
[silverham] Great, I assume paying via Google Wallet works, just like amex does.
